chatbot.intro: Hello! 👋 I am the FSRE AI assistant. How can I help you today? You can ask me about the timetable, exams, labs, scholarships, or anything else related to the faculty.

contact.response: The faculty is located at Matice hrvatske bb, 88000 Mostar. For general inquiries, call +387 36 337-001 or email fsre@sum.ba. For student-related matters, contact student services at +387 36 337-003 or referada@fsre.sum.ba.

exams.response: You can register for exams through [Studomat](https://studomat.sum.ba/), where you can also view your grades and personal details. The same functionality is available in the e-Indeks mobile app. For questions about exam periods or registration deadlines, check the news on the FSRE website or contact student services at referada@fsre.sum.ba or +387 36 337-003.

labs.response: Laboratory exercises are part of your weekly schedule and appear in the Timetable tab of this app. You will be notified of changes to the schedule in the app. Course materials and assignments for lab work are typically available on the [e-Learning platform](https://eucenje.sum.ba/moodle/). For specific questions about a lab, contact the professor or student services.

schedule.response: You can view your timetable in the Timetable tab of this app, where you can filter by academic year, day, department, and receive notifications about schedule changes. There is also an [online timetable viewer](https://fsre.edupage.org/timetable/view.php) on the FSRE Edupage website. Department-specific schedules and exam dates are also available on the [FSRE website](https://fsre.sum.ba).
schedule.text: Where can I see the timetable?

privacy.response: This chatbot is powered by [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/). When you send a message, it goes from your device directly to Google's Gemini API using the Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite model. FSRE app developers do not run their own AI servers and do not store your chat messages or chat history on any FSRE/SUM servers. Your conversation exists only in this app session on your device. The app may save non-chat preferences locally on your device, such as theme, language, and timetable filters. Google processes API requests under its [Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy) and [Gemini API terms](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms). For how Google handles API data, see those Google resources.
